title: Multiplayer Iodine Clock Oscillation Lab
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that simulates a multiplayer iodine clock reaction lab where multiple beakers undergo periodic colorless-to-blue oscillation (Briggs-Rauscher style). The scene must be fully interactive and expose all state via window.__3D_STATE__.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Create a lab bench (box geometry, brown/wood color, ~16x0.3x6) centered at y=0.
- Place 4 cylindrical glass beakers in a row on the bench at x positions [-4.5, -1.5, 1.5, 4.5], each with radius 0.6, height 2.5, transparent glass material (opacity 0.3). Each beaker contains a liquid mesh (cylinder, radius 0.55) whose color oscillates.
- Add a magnetic stirrer pad under each beaker (flat dark cylinder) with a small spinning bar visible inside each beaker liquid.
- Add a wall-mounted digital clock/timer display behind the bench.

CHEMISTRY SIMULATION:
- Each beaker simulates an iodine clock oscillation cycle. The liquid color transitions periodically between colorless (hex 0xE8E8F0) and deep blue (hex 0x0A0A6E).
- Each beaker has an independent oscillation period controlled by its concentration ratio. Default periods: Beaker0=4s, Beaker1=5s, Beaker2=6s, Beaker3=8s.
- The color transition is NOT instant: each beaker spends ~70% of its period in colorless phase, then transitions to blue over ~10% of the period, holds blue for ~10%, then fades back to colorless over ~10%.
- Track each beaker's phase as a float 0.0-1.0 where 0.0-0.7 = colorless, 0.7-0.8 = transition to blue, 0.8-0.9 = blue hold, 0.9-1.0 = transition back to colorless.
- The stirrer bar in each beaker rotates at a speed proportional to 1/period (faster stirring = shorter period).
- Track total completed oscillation cycles per beaker.

MULTIPLAYER SYNC FEATURE:
- A 'Sync All' button that resets all beakers to phase 0.0 simultaneously so they restart in unison.
- A 'Cascade Mode' toggle button that, when active, staggers the beakers so each starts 25% of its own period after the previous one (beaker0 starts at phase 0, beaker1 at phase 0.25, beaker2 at phase 0.5, beaker3 at phase 0.75). When toggled off, beakers resume independent oscillation from current phase.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Click on any beaker to select it (highlight with a yellow emissive outline). Store selectedBeakerIndex (0-3, or -1 if none).
- When a beaker is selected, pressing UP arrow increases its concentration (decreases period by 0.5s, minimum 1.5s). DOWN arrow decreases concentration (increases period by 0.5s, maximum 12s).
- Press 'P' to pause/resume the entire simulation. When paused, all phases freeze.
- Press 'R' to add a reagent burst to the selected beaker: immediately jump its phase to 0.7 (force transition to blue).
- Press 'T' to toggle temperature mode: when active, all periods are halved (reaction speeds up). Toggle off restores original periods.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left: show 'Elapsed Time: Xs' (integer seconds since start).
- Top-right: show 'Temperature: Normal' or 'Temperature: Elevated'.
- Below each beaker (as a DOM overlay or 3D text): show 'Beaker N' label, current period in seconds, and cycle count.
- The 'Sync All' and 'Cascade Mode' buttons should be DOM buttons positioned at bottom-center.
- Show 'PAUSED' overlay text centered on screen when simulation is paused.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose the following on every animation frame:
{
  sceneReady: true,
  elapsedTime: <float seconds since start>,
  paused: <bool>,
  temperatureMode: <'normal'|'elevated'>,
  cascadeMode: <bool>,
  selectedBeakerIndex: <int -1 to 3>,
  beakers: [
    {
      index: <0-3>,
      phase: <float 0.0-1.0>,
      period: <float seconds>,
      basePeriod: <float seconds, before temperature modifier>,
      cycleCount: <int>,
      colorHex: <string like '#0A0A6E'>,
      isBlue: <bool, true if phase between 0.7 and 0.9>,
      stirrerRPM: <float>
    }
  ],
  totalCycles: <int, sum of all beaker cycleCount>,
  syncCount: <int, number of times Sync All was pressed>,
  beakerCount: 4
}
physics_constraints: Each beaker oscillation phase must be continuous and wrap from 1.0 back to 0.0. Phase must always be in [0.0, 1.0). Color interpolation must be smooth during transition windows (phase 0.7-0.8 and 0.9-1.0). Stirrer RPM must be proportional to 1/effectivePeriod. Temperature mode must exactly halve effective periods. Period adjustments must clamp to [1.5, 12.0]. Total cycles must equal sum of individual beaker cycles at all times. Phase must freeze exactly when paused.
